### A Glorious Future
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/glorious-future
Passage: Matthew 13:43
Points:
- Jesus explains that the field represents the world, where the kingdom and evil coexist side by side.
- The apparent delay of the kingdom's final judgment does not mean that judgment has been cancelled.
- God permits the weeds to remain temporarily so that true believers are not harmed or uprooted before maturity.
- Believers facing present suffering and opposition can take comfort knowing they will ultimately be vindicated and shine in glory.
